input.query: Sentry vs Rollbar vs Bugsnag pricing 2026 error monitoring plans

content.text:
**Recommendation: Sentry**, unless your team is mostly mobile or you want a cheaper per-seat model, in which case Rollbar is the alternative. Verify current prices on each vendor's site before you buy, because the third-party pricing I found conflicts.

| | **Sentry** | **Rollbar** | **Bugsnag** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Strengths** | Broadest SDK and integration coverage (frontend, backend, mobile, and performance tracing), large community, strong release and source-map workflows | Unlimited users and projects on every plan, good grouping and AI-assisted triage, simple setup | Strong mobile and crash reporting, clean error-triage UI, good stability-score tracking |
| **Weaknesses** | Costs rise with event and performance volume, and seat pricing can add up as you grow | Smaller ecosystem, less depth in performance tracing | Pricing is tied to events, and the richer tiers often require a sales quote |
| **Free tier** | Yes | Yes (reported at about 5K events/month) | Yes (about 50K events/month) |
| **Pricing model** | Free plus paid tiers, reportedly about $26–29/month for entry paid plans, and a second member moves you onto a paid plan | Unlimited users, scales on events, session replays, and AI credits; sources disagree on Essentials/Advanced prices | Event-based tiers: Select ~$20/month, Preferred ~$33/month, Enterprise on request |
| **Best fit** | Web and backend teams that want one tool for errors and performance | Teams that want everyone to have access without per-seat fees | Mobile-heavy apps |

**Why Sentry for 10 people:** it covers the most platforms with the least setup, and most engineers already know it. The main risk is cost once event volume grows, so set sampling limits and spend caps early.

**What would change my answer:**
- If you are mostly native iOS/Android, choose Bugsnag.
- If the per-seat cost of Sentry matters more than ecosystem breadth, choose Rollbar, since all of its plans include unlimited users.

Before you commit, I'd check three things on the vendor pricing pages: your expected monthly event volume, whether the plan you need includes performance monitoring, and whether seats are charged. The pricing figures I found came from aggregator sites that disagree with each other, so treat them as rough.

Sources for the pricing comparison:
- [G2 comparison](https://www.g2.com/compare/bugsnag-vs-sentry-vs-rollbar)
- [CostBench: Sentry vs Rollbar](https://costbench.com/compare/sentry-vs-rollbar/)
- [CostBench: Rollbar vs Bugsnag](https://costbench.com/compare/bugsnag-vs-rollbar/)
- [CostBench: Bugsnag plans](https://www.costbench.com/software/error-tracking/bugsnag/)
- [CostBench: Rollbar plans](https://costbench.com/software/error-tracking/rollbar/)
- [Toolradar: Sentry pricing](https://toolradar.com/tools/sentry/pricing)
- [Toolradar: Rollbar pricing](https://toolradar.com/tools/rollbar/pricing)
- [Rollbar pricing](https://www.rollbar.com/pricing-for-agents)
